fullDescription.text: WebView addJavascriptInterface (JS bridge) — high-impact if content is untrusted. (in config.properties; seen: addJavascriptInterface(bridge))

help.text:
Avoid addJavascriptInterface on untrusted content; if required, expose minimal APIs and validate all inputs.

Revalidate: Rebuild and re-scan with --sast; dex-webview-js-bridge should clear when the bridge is removed or no longer matched.
help.markdown:
**Remediation**

Avoid addJavascriptInterface on untrusted content; if required, expose minimal APIs and validate all inputs.

**Revalidate**

Rebuild and re-scan with --sast; dex-webview-js-bridge should clear when the bridge is removed or no longer matched.

fullDescription.text: Cleartext HTTP URL; prefer HTTPS. (in config.properties; seen: url=http://evil.example.com/api)

help.text:
Use HTTPS/TLS for all sensitive traffic. Replace http:// endpoints with https:// and enforce TLS in the network stack.

Revalidate: Rebuild and re-scan with --sast. Expect dex-/jar-/ipa-cleartext hits for those URLs to disappear (schema/example URLs may still match).

fullDescription.text: AWS access key id-like string (AKIA…). (in config.properties; seen: key=AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE)

help.text:
Rotate the AWS access key immediately. Remove it from the app; use Cognito/STS or a backend that vends temporary credentials.

Revalidate: After rotation and rebuild, re-scan with --sast; secret-*/aws-access-key findings should be gone. Confirm key disabled in AWS IAM.

fullDescription.text: Weak or deprecated Cipher.getInstance transformation (e.g. DES/ECB/RC4). (in config.properties; seen: Cipher.getInstance("DES"))

help.text:
Remove weak crypto algorithm names from native/JAR code paths; use approved algorithms (AES-GCM, SHA-256+).

Revalidate: Rebuild and re-scan with --sast; so-weak-crypto / jar-weak-crypto should clear when weak algorithm strings are gone.
